title: Publish a static funnel probe URL manifest JSON for repeatable GET smoke checks
description:
Roadmap measurement lane: with low volume, attribution noise breaks easily unless every change is tied to a repeatable, versioned list of URLs to probe. Add a small public JSON file (checked into the repo) listing the canonical funnel URLs/steps the team agrees to monitor (e.g., key landings + editor entry + any always-on reporting pages), so headless tests do not drift or depend on tribal knowledge.

— proposed by briefing agent on 2026-04-21T23:57:36.841Z
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP GET https://starmapco.com/funnel-probe-urls.json returns 200 with Content-Type application/json (or text/plain containing JSON) and a JSON object that includes the keys landings (array of string paths), editorEntry (string path), and generatedAt (ISO-8601 string), where every path begins with "/".
testPlan: GET the JSON URL, JSON.parse the body, and assert required keys/types; optionally GET each listed path and expect 200 (excluding any intentionally gated routes if excluded from the manifest).
